# idsec_identity_tenant_suffix (Data Source)

The Identity service tenant suffix data source. It reads a single tenant suffix and fails if the tenant does not have it.
<!-- BEGIN CUSTOM NOTES -->
<!-- END CUSTOM NOTES -->

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "idsec_identity_tenant_suffix" "mysuffix" {
  suffix = "example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The server's key for the suffix, or the suffix itself. Set this or suffix.
- `suffix` (String) The tenant login suffix, for example example.com, compared case-insensitively. Set this or id.
